name: xandr-mcp
description: Microsoft Invest (Xandr DSP, discontinued) (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, pause_resume. E

platform_mcp_xandr_username.title: PLATFORM_MCP_XANDR_USERNAME
platform_mcp_xandr_username.description: Xandr / Microsoft Advertising platform API user name (an API-enabled user created through the API Onboarding Process).

platform_mcp_xandr_password.title: PLATFORM_MCP_XANDR_PASSWORD
platform_mcp_xandr_password.description: Password of that API user. POST /auth {auth: {username, password}} returns a token valid for 2 hours after the last call (24-hour hard expiry); the runtime re-authenticates on expiry or 401 (the API allows 10 successful logins per 5 minutes).

platform_mcp_xandr_advertiser_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_XANDR_ADVERTISER_ID
platform_mcp_xandr_advertiser_id.description: Advertiser id that owns the line items; required for pause_resume (PUT /line-item?id=…&advertiser_id=…).

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /user?current ('View the current user') with `Authorization: <token>` (no scheme).

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: GET /advertiser?start_element=0&num_elements=100 ('View all of your advertisers'); the first 100 advertisers (the vocabulary's list_accounts takes no page argument), total in `total`.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /line-item?advertiser_id=…&start_element&num_elements — line items are the buying unit that carries state and budget (campaigns under augmented line items are generated). `status` filters on state (active / inactive). Budgets live on raw.budget_intervals (seamless line items) or raw.daily_budget (legacy), in the line item's currency, so `budget` is not mapped.
